2645-5928-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Balduvian Trading Post.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Balduvian Trading Post's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{R}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

2105-5778-6968-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

728-1052-3175.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

3240-6351-6462-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
3240-6351-6462-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1274-7855.easyPrerequisites: You control another Goblin, Orc or Army.
1274-7855.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-7855.description:
Activate Heliod by paying {1}{W}, giving The Great Goblin lifelink until end of turn.
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on another Goblin, Orc or Army you control.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 2 life due to its lifelink.
Repeat from step 3.
1274-7855.notes: Any method to give The Great Goblin lifelink can be used instead of Heliod's ability if desired.

2021-2060-2445-3129.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3680-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3680-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Stunt Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3680-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2033-7175-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-7175-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-7175-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1912-2060-5140-7315.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-5140-7315.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-2511-4147-4294.easyPrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-2511-4147-4294.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R} and paying any commander tax if relevant.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Etali.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from Step 3.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

539-2511-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

341-3532-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
341-3532-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

1987-4311-4423-6893.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

224-907-3314-3430-6664.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {G} and/or {W}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-907-3314-3430-6664.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1168-1651-4935-6751-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-4935-6751-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-4935-6751-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

618-1938-4050.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1350-3821-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{U}.
1350-3821-5778.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

500-1308-3035-4688-4751.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nadier.
500-1308-3035-4688-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting at least seven +1/+1 counters on Nadier, and the remaining nine +1/+1 counters on any creature(s) you control.
Kill Nadier, triggering its ability, creating at least twenty 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

1702-2104-3212.description:
Activate Jace's zero loyalty ability, putting Temporal Manipulation on top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Temporal Manipulation, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {1}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.

uses.n: Journey to Eternity // Atzal, Cave of Eternity

1888-2792-3546.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce {3}{B}{G}.
1888-2792-3546.description:
Activate High Market by tapping it and sacrificing Great Whale, gaining you 1 life.
Activate Atzal's second ability by paying {3}{B}{G} and tapping it, returning Great Whale to the battlefield.
Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping Atzal, High Market, and five other lands that can produce {3}{B}{G}.
Repeat.
